title: build_cellranger_arc_reference
description: Build a Cell Ranger-arc and -atac compatible reference folder from user-supplied genome FASTA and gene GTF files. Creates a new folder named after the genome.

genome_fasta.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `genome_sequence.fa.gz`

annotation_gtf.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `annotation.gtf.gz`

motifs_file.description: Transcription factor motifs in JASPAR format. See https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-multiome-atac-gex/software/pipelines/latest/advanced/references

non_nuclear_contigs.description: Name(s) of contig(s) that do not have any chromatin structure, for example, mitochondria or plastids. These contigs are excluded from peak calling since the entire contig will be "open" due to a lack of chromatin structure. Leave empty if there are no such contigs.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `cellranger_reference`

genome.description: Name of the genome. This will be the name of the intermediate output folder
genome.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, default: `output`, example: `GRCh38`

organism.description: Name of the organism. This is displayed in the web summary but is otherwise not used in the analysis.

subset_regex.description: Will subset the reference chromosomes using the given regex.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
